guard: The gated backup inventory check compares the inventory to BROKER TRUTH (its own stream list), not to the inventory's output. A family removed from either side must redden the check by name (#643).
proveWith: pnpm mutation-proof --config packages/core/smoke/mutations/backup-inventory.json   # --config resolves against the repo root, never the cwd
why: The gated suite provisions a real space and compares the broker's own stream enumeration to
the independently maintained backup inventory. This keeps the check non-circular: removing a
family from either creation or accounting must fail by name rather than shrinking both sides.
The mutations cover a backed-up family, a legacy excluded family, and one endpoint-plane family
whose downstream ownership list also drives teardown and its sole delete credential.

mutations.name: a backed-up family (the ACL registry) is dropped from the inventory
mutations.expectRed: the broker's own stream set equals the backup inventory exactly
mutations.cell: the broker's own stream set equals the backup inventory exactly
mutations.note: The broker still creates the stream (driven by streams.ts, not the inventory), so it appears on the broker side only and the validator reports it as unexpected.

mutations.name: an excluded family (the presence bucket) is dropped from the inventory
mutations.expectRed: the broker's own stream set equals the backup inventory exactly
mutations.cell: the broker's own stream set equals the backup inventory exactly
mutations.note: Excluded streams are part of the validated set too: the space must account for every stream it owns, whether or not it enters the artifact.

mutations.name: an endpoint-plane family is dropped from the downstream ownership inventory
mutations.expectRed: the broker's own stream set equals the backup inventory exactly
mutations.cell: the broker's own stream set equals the backup inventory exactly
mutations.note: Creation remains independent and still adds EPR, so the broker reports it as unexpected when the downstream inventory forgets it.
